english: For each positive integer $n$, let $T_n=1\cdot2+2\cdot3+3\cdot4+\cdots+n(n+1)$. Then the value of $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{n+3}{T_n}$ is ______.
hindi: प्रत्येक धनात्मक पूर्णांक $n$ के लिए माना $T_n=1\cdot2+2\cdot3+3\cdot4+\cdots+n(n+1)$ है। तब $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{n+3}{T_n}$ का मान ______ है।
originality_note: New: the denominator is itself a telescoped sum of products of consecutive integers, and the non-constant numerator n + 3 must be split as (n + 2) + 1 to produce two telescoping pieces of different orders (way 5: product-of-linear-factors sum feeding a linear-denominator telescoping). Closest known: 'sum of 1/(1.2 + 2.3 + ... + n(n+1))' type exercises. Different because: the numerator n + 3 prevents a single telescoping and needs a split into first- and second-order pieces.
blueprint_concepts: Sum of a telescopic series whose nth term is product of linear factors in denominator
Sum of a telescopic series whose nth term is product of linear factors

concept_use.Sum of a telescopic series whose nth ter: The term 3(n+3)/(n(n+1)(n+2)) is split into 1/(n(n+1)) and 1/(n(n+1)(n+2)), each a telescoping series with linear factors in the denominator (sums 1 and 1/4).

key_step: Getting T_n = n(n+1)(n+2)/3 and splitting (n+3) as (n+2) + 1 into two telescoping pieces.
justification: Two telescoping techniques chained (product sum, then denominators with a numerator split); numerical. Level 3 like 2021-P1-Q15 (L3) telescoping.
